name: El Geneina

queries.query: El Geneina Sudan official cadastral map parcel GIS land registry West Darfur
queries.result: Official Sudan National Information Centre material identified the Sudan Spatial Portal as a national interactive map browser advertising OGC WMS and WFS services. Official Judiciary-linked Aqari material describes national land-registration services. No El Geneina-specific public cadastral viewer, parcel layer, safe parcel identifier, schema/CRS response, or geometry was found in the bounded discovery.

queries.query: السجل العقاري الجنينة السودان خريطة مساحية GIS الأراضي
queries.result: Arabic official results confirmed the Sudan Spatial Portal's advertised WMS/WFS capability and Aqari's land-registration and property-record remit. The results did not expose a public El Geneina parcel endpoint or safe parcel geometry. A non-official Sudan GIS result explicitly says parcel identification requires a survey-data layer that is not yet enabled and was not used as registry evidence.
